Hi Emily — great to meet you and Rajiv on the call today. Quick recap and next steps so we have a shared MAP and timeline.

Post-call recap:
- Discovery: Aurelia will embed Redwood for inference in product search and chat flows (high QPS, PII filtered at ingestion).
- Evaluation focus: latency SLOs, data isolation, and SOC 2 evidence for security/compliance.
- Procurement signals: procurement/PO process looks standard, target close depends on legal + security review.

Draft MAP (attached): high-level milestones and owners. Key milestone for this thread: Security review / SOC 2 package delivery. Proposed milestones and owners: 
1) MAP signoff (commercial/legal) — Owner: Emily / Procurement — Target: 2026-08-20
2) Security review kickoff (Aurelia security) — Owner: Rajiv — Target: 2026-08-03
3) SOC 2 package delivery (Redwood provides SOC2 summary, report, evidence index) — Owner: Marissa / Security (Redwood) — Target: 2026-08-06 (initial package)
4) Evidence follow-ups & QA — Owners: Rajiv / Monica — Target: 2026-08-13

Dependencies: legal redlines (Aurelia legal), procurement PO, and any extra evidence queries from your security team.

Ask: Can you confirm Rajiv (or alternate) will own the Aurelia side of the security review and if Aug 6 for the initial SOC2 package delivery works? We can provide the SOC2 report, a short one-page summary, and an indexed evidence checklist.

Attachments: MAP-draft-Redwood-Aurelia-2026.pdf (draft MAP)

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm security owner and accept tentative dates (reply here)
- Redwood (Monica + Rishi) will prepare SOC2 summary + evidence index by Aug 5 and upload a secure Drive link
- If procurement needs a PO or counterparty details, loop procurement@aurelia-tech.com

Thanks Marissa — appreciated the clear MAP. Rajiv will own the security review on our side. A couple notes on timing and evidence: 

- Rajiv confirmed: initial security kickoff call with our InfoSec scheduled for Mon 2026-08-03.
- Target for us to receive the initial SOC 2 package from Redwood: 2026-08-06. That gives our team one week to triage and raise any follow-up questions.

Aurelia needs the following items in the initial package (preferable as PDFs + an evidence index spreadsheet):
1) Most recent SOC 2 Type II report (last 12 months)
2) SOC 2 bridge letter (if applicable)
3) Evidence index spreadsheet mapping controls to artifacts (login: audit logs, user access reviews, change management tickets, config baselines)
4) Network diagram and data flow showing where customer data is processed
5) Encryption key management description (KMS/HSM)
6) List of subservice organizations and third-party vendors

Please also include a point-of-contact at Redwood for evidence follow-ups (Slack/email). If you can hit Aug 6 for the initial upload that would keep us on track for MAP signoff by Aug 20.

Thanks,
Emily Carter
Head of Product Security | Aurelia Tech
emily@aurelia-tech.com
